privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.lead: How DIGIRANX PRO LTD collects, uses and protects your personal data.
sections: Who We Are

DIGIRANX PRO LTD ("we", "us") is a digital marketing agency registered in England and Wales, based at Office 1922, 85 Dunstall Hill, Wolverhampton, WV6 0SR. We are the data controller for personal data collected through this website. Contact us at info@digiranxpro.com or +44 7445 652671.
Information We Collect
Details you give us through our forms, such as your name, email address, phone number and business information.
Messages you send us by email, phone or social media.
Technical data such as IP address, browser type and pages visited, collected through cookies and analytics tools.
How We Use Your Information
To reply to your enquiry and provide quotes.
To deliver the services you have agreed to buy from us.
To send service updates and, only with your consent, marketing emails.
To improve our website and understand how visitors use it.
Legal Basis for Processing

We process personal data under UK GDPR on the basis of your consent, the performance of a contract with you, our legitimate interests in running and improving our business, and compliance with legal obligations.
Sharing Your Information
We never sell your data. We only share it with trusted providers who help us run our business, such as hosting, email and analytics services, and only under contracts that protect your data.
How Long We Keep Data
We keep enquiry data for up to 24 months and client records for 6 years after our contract ends, as required for accounting and legal purposes.
Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict the use of your personal data, to object to processing, and to data portability. To make a request, email info@digiranxpro.com. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk).
Changes to This Policy
We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be published on this page.

cookie-policy.title: Cookie Policy
cookie-policy.lead: What cookies we use on this website and how you can control them.
sections: What Are Cookies?
Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site work and tell us how visitors use it.
Cookies We Use
Essential cookies that make the website work, such as security and form cookies.
Analytics cookies, such as Google Analytics, that show us which pages are visited so we can improve the site.
Marketing cookies, such as the Google Ads tag and Meta Pixel, that measure our advertising. These are only set with your consent.
Managing Cookies

You can accept or reject non-essential cookies through our cookie banner, and change your choice at any time. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings, although some parts of the website may not work properly.
Contact Us
If you have any questions about our use of cookies, email info@digiranxpro.com.
